lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from Beirut Municipality engineering department cadastral records and digitized as vector geometries. Data covers four administrative zones (Beirut, Bourj Hammoud, Sinn El Fil, Furn El Chebbak) with 25,573 individual building records attributed with official plot numbers and sequential building identifiers assigned by OCHA.
